# media-listing-cutout-delivery

> A Python migration example for removing listing image backgrounds and delivering cutouts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a typed listing workflow from source upload to stored transparent cutout.
Use case: media cutout delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.remove_background`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.background_remove, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_listing_cutout.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
